title: One caller at a time holds an inference slot
intention: inference_domain, as the owner of the inference slot, lets one caller at a time into each endpoint: the one function that opens the slot takes an exclusive per-endpoint lock bounded by the call's timeout and raises a named SlotHeld when the slot stays held.
why: Akien via peer akiendelllinux_cc_0 as F39, 2026-10-08, verbatim: "it sounds to me like we don't need it at all... this is deeper than i designed. what i said was everything needed to be able to be worked on live. self testing, self checking... as long as things are working, we don't need to retest 400 proofs for something i never thought we needed." The ruling retires the tester's network namespace (d80360545e91), whose only recorded why was the 2026-07-13 incident: nine test runs saturating the single inference slot (cairn/devices/tester/isolation.py:15-20). Census 2026-10-08: inference_domain has no flock, semaphore or queue; host._urllib_transport (host.py:136-147) is a bare urlopen. So the protection moves to the slot's owner before the namespace goes.
traces_to: Law 4 (one consumer per slot becomes physics at the one function every caller passes, instead of a namespace that bound proofs only); Law 6 (the slot is inference_domain's to gate); RULE 1 (the rule lives inside the component that owns the resource).
how: cairn/devices/inference_domain/host.py: _urllib_transport takes fcntl.flock(LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB) on $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/cairn/inference_domain/slots/<sha256(scheme://host:port)[:12]>.lock (falling back to /run/user/<uid> when the variable is unset), retrying until the call's own timeout, then raising SlotHeld(HostUnreachable) naming the endpoint, the lock path and the wait. The lock wraps only the urlopen; installed_models' GET of /api/tags does not take it. The lock is not under ~/.cairn because the tester's instance seal swaps ~/.cairn per run, so a lock there would never be shared with a live caller. Proof change is question open-c64930dd5ef8.

Hollow: reverting host.py reds teeth 1 and 2. Every inference_domain proof stays green. Horizon: the tester's retirement (d80360545e91) lands with no saturation trouble from a concurrent proof run. Wrong intent if a second dialer of the slot is found outside host.py (the sole_path sieve says none).

builder_notes: WHERE: cairn/devices/inference_domain/host.py _urllib_transport :136-147; SlotHeld beside HostUnreachable (a subclass, so every caller that already handles an unreachable host handles it). LOCK IDIOM: the house flock — cairn/devices/bus/server.py:359, ground_loop guard.py:67, cairn/tools/artifact/artifact.py:294 — copy the open/flock/close shape, poll LOCK_NB with a short sleep until the deadline. FIXTURE: two subprocesses (multiprocessing or subprocess.run of python -c) each monkeypatch urllib.request.urlopen to a stand-in that writes enter/exit timestamps to a scratch file and sleeps ~1s; point XDG_RUNTIME_DIR at a scratch_dir for the proof so the live lock dir is untouched. No real host, no network.

decisions.text: D1: the build's FIRST commit adds only cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/test_one_caller_at_a_time_holds_an_inference_slot.py. Its PROVES is {'d0672a46aa7e': {'1': 'test_one_endpoint_never_holds_two_callers', '2': 'test_a_held_slot_refuses_by_name_and_never_dials', '3': 'test_two_endpoints_do_overlap'}}. Each tooth spawns real child interpreters with XDG_RUNTIME_DIR set to its own scratch_dir, and the endpoints are fixture names under .invalid. Each child replaces urllib.request.urlopen with a stand-in that stamps enter and exit around a sleep, then calls host._urllib_transport(url + '/api/chat', b'{}', timeout) once. Tooth 2 reads SlotHeld's endpoint and lock_path attributes and its message, and requires the lock path to lie under the scratch runtime dir and end in .lock. Measured at this commit through bin/cairn test --exec: teeth 1 and 2 red ('two callers were inside one endpoint at once'; 'host publishes no SlotHeld'), tooth 3 PASS.

D2: cairn/devices/inference_domain/host.py adds 'import fcntl', 'import hashlib', 'import os', 'import time' and 'import urllib.parse' beside its imports, and 'from pathlib import Path'. Directly after class HostUnreachable it defines class SlotHeld(HostUnreachable). Its docstring: the slot's owner admits one caller per endpoint, and a caller that waits its whole timeout is refused by name. Being a HostUnreachable, the failover walk treats a held slot as an unreachable host, which is the behaviour d0672a46aa7e wants and needs no change there. __init__(self, endpoint: str, lock_path, waited: float) sets self.endpoint, self.lock_path = str(lock_path) and self.waited, and calls super().__init__ with the message f'inference slot at {endpoint} is held by another caller: waited {waited:.2f}s for {lock_path}'. Two module functions follow. _endpoint_of(url): s = urllib.parse.urlsplit(url); returns f'{s.scheme}://{s.hostname}:{s.port or (443 if s.scheme == "https" else 80)}'. _slot_lock_path(endpoint): base = os.environ.get('XDG_RUNTIME_DIR') or f'/run/user/{os.getuid()}'; returns Path(base) / 'cairn' / 'inference_domain' / 'slots' / (hashlib.sha256(endpoint.encode()).hexdigest()[:12] + '.lock'). A comment says why the lock is not under ~/.cairn: the tester's instance seal swaps it.

D3: _urllib_transport keeps its signature and its request build. Before urlopen it computes endpoint = _endpoint_of(url) and path = _slot_lock_path(endpoint), runs path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True), opens fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDWR | os.O_CREAT, 0o600) and records started = time.monotonic(). If timeout is None it calls fcntl.flock(fd, fcntl.LOCK_EX), which blocks. Otherwise it loops on fcntl.flock(fd, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB): on BlockingIOError, if time.monotonic() - started >= timeout it closes fd and raises SlotHeld(endpoint, path, time.monotonic() - started); else it sleeps 0.05. Once the lock is held, the existing try/with-urlopen/except block runs unchanged inside an outer try whose finally does os.close(fd), which releases the lock. The docstring gains one paragraph naming d0672a46aa7e and the 2026-07-13 saturation. _urllib_get is not touched.
